$Comment: The yearly keepsake: light the Hollow Lantern with Old Jack, once a season, and keep it.
It inherits the yearly occurrence from Hallows_Eve_Hallowed_Base, so each year mints its own
copy and @year in the title reads as that year. Feat files it with the feats, earned only.
The hallowed tag counts it toward The Hallowed, and season_keepsake toward the Seasons of Orbis
ladder, which counts each season's keepsake once: that tag goes on a season's yearly keepsake
and on nothing else. It pays nothing itself: the Hollow Lantern is The Hollow Lantern quest's own
pay (Quests/HallowsEvePack/_Hallows_Eve/Old_Jack_Lantern.json), collected at Old Jack with the
rest, so a player never has to visit the achievements page for the year's keepsake.
